description: Highway Network is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by OpenDataNI. This dataset contains centreline information regarding roads in Northern Ireland that are adopted and maintained by DfI Roads. Use the ADOPTIONSTATUSNAME column to filter the data and to show current adopted road sections. Note this is a 'live' link and is updated each evening to include any new road sections. Coverage: OpenDataNI. The portal files it under the publisher OpenDataNI. Its tags are DRD, Highway, Network, Roads, Transport. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, ESRI MAP, XML. The portal shows 2026-06-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
